findings.evidence: Lines 217-223, 227-233, 236-240 have identical proof skeletons (`rw [Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff] at hv ⊢; rw [toEnd_apply_apply] at hv ⊢; rw [leibniz_lie h _ v, <one triple relation>, hv, ...]`). Each uses exactly one of `t.lie_h_e_smul` / `t.lie_lie_smul_f` / nothing. Mathlib has no eigenspace-shift lemma for a single Lie algebra element (`grep -rn "mem_eigenspace" Mathlib/Algebra/Lie/` gives only `CartanCriterion.lean:100,135`, `Sl2.lean:267`, `Weights/Killing.lean:387`; `Weights/Basic.lean` only covers genWeightSpaces over a subalgebra), so the general form is new API, not a duplicate.
findings.fix: State once, without the triple: `theorem lie_mem_eigenspace_add {x : L} {c : K} (hx : ⁅h, x⁆ = c • x) (hv : v ∈ (toEnd K L M h).eigenspace μ) : ⁅x, v⁆ ∈ (toEnd K L M h).eigenspace (μ + c)`, with the existing proof body (`leibniz_lie h x v, hx, hv, smul_lie, lie_smul, add_smul; abel`). Derive the three current lemmas as one-liners: `e` from `t.lie_h_e_smul (R := K)`; `f` from `t.lie_lie_smul_f (R := K)` with `c = -2` and `sub_eq_add_neg`; `h` from `lie_self`/`zero_smul` with `c = 0` and `add_zero`.
findings.issue: `lie_mem_eigenspace_add_two` (217), `lie_mem_eigenspace_sub_two` (227) and `lie_mem_eigenspace` (236) are three copies of one proof: each only needs `⁅h, x⁆ = c • x` for a single `x : L` and scalar `c`, not the whole `IsSl2Triple` (`h ≠ 0` and `⁅e,f⁆ = h` are never touched). The general lemma is what Layer 2 actually calls — a root vector `x` with `⁅h, x⁆ = α(h) • x` shifts the `h`-eigenvalue by `α(h)` — so the sl₂-specialized form under-generalizes and duplicates a proof three times.

summary: Hypotheses are tight and the htop-free/irreducibility-free statements sit at the right level. One issue: the three ladder lemmas are separate special cases of a single general weight-shift lemma that the PR could state directly, and that is the form Layer 2 needs for root vectors.
